validation.title: Check the form
validation.body: Some details are missing or invalid. Review the highlighted fields and try again.

unauthenticated.title: Please sign in again
unauthenticated.body: Your session has ended. Sign in to continue where you left off.

forbidden.title: You do not have access
forbidden.body: Your role does not permit this action. Ask an administrator if you believe this is wrong.

notFound.title: Not found
notFound.body: This record does not exist, or it is no longer available.

conflict.title: Someone else changed this
conflict.body: The record was updated by someone else. Refresh to see the current version before continuing.

unprocessable.title: Cannot process this
unprocessable.body: The request was understood but could not be completed as submitted.

rateLimited.title: Too many requests
rateLimited.body: Wait a moment before trying again.

internal.title: Something went wrong
internal.body: The problem has been recorded. Try again, and tell your administrator if it continues.

unavailable.title: Service temporarily unavailable
unavailable.body: The system is not responding. Wait a moment and try again.

network.title: No connection
network.body: Your device could not reach the server. Check the network and try again. If this happened after you submitted something, check its status before resubmitting.

timeout.title: The request timed out
timeout.body: The server took too long to respond. The request may still have been processed — check before resubmitting.

intake.title: Request an emergency visit
intake.intro: Tell us what has happened and we will pass it to the clinical team. This form does not assess how serious your condition is.

facility.label: Which facility?
facility.hint: Choose the nearest one if you are not sure.

phone.label: Your phone number
phone.hint: So the clinical team can reach you. We will only use it about this request.

category.label: What best describes the situation?
category.notTriage: Pick the closest one. It does not assess how serious the situation is — it only tells the team what to expect.

peopleCount.label: How many people need help?
peopleCount.hint: The total number of people this request covers.

description.label: What has happened?
description.hint: In your own words. Include when it started and anything that has changed since.

intake.urgentNotice: This service is not for life-threatening emergencies. If someone is in immediate danger, call your local emergency number now.

receipt.title: Request received
receipt.body: Keep this reference. You will need it if you contact the facility about this request.
receipt.trackingHint: Keep this token safe and private. It is how this request is verified as yours when you check on it or cancel it.
receipt.noAssessment: Your request has been passed on. It has not been assessed, and no one has been assigned to you yet.

errors.name: Enter your name.
errors.phoneFormat: Enter a phone number, including the area code.
errors.forSelf: Tell us if this request is for you.
errors.peopleCount: Enter how many people need help — at least 1.
errors.preferredContact: Choose how we should contact you.
errors.descriptionShort: Please add a little more detail.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests have been sent from this device. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.unavailable: The service is temporarily unavailable. Your request was not sent. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.serverValidation: Some details were not accepted. Check the form and try again.
errors.facilityNotAccepting: This facility is not accepting requests right now. Choose another facility or contact it directly.
errors.generic: Your request was not sent. Try again in a moment.

intake.pageIntro: If someone needs urgent medical help, send a request and the clinical team will see it. You will get a reference to keep.

facilitiesUnavailable.title: This service is temporarily unavailable
facilitiesUnavailable.body: We cannot reach the list of facilities right now, so we cannot accept a request through this form. If this is an emergency, contact your nearest facility directly.

facilities.pageIntro: Search the published facility directory by name or location, and narrow it by what a facility offers. Results are public information only.
facilities.searchPlaceholder: e.g. Mombasa, or the name of a facility

facet.emergency24hHint: An emergency department staffed day and night

facilities.resultsCount: {count, plural, =0 {No results} one {1 result} other {# results}}
facilities.emptyBody: Try a shorter name, or clear the filters and search again.
facilities.unavailableBody: The facility directory could not be loaded. Try again shortly.

track.pageIntro: Check what has happened since you sent an emergency request.
track.title: Track an emergency request
track.intro: Enter the tracking token from your receipt to see the current state of your request.
track.tokenHint: It is printed under the reference number on the receipt you received when you sent the request.
track.keepToken: Keep your token — you can use it to check again.
track.urgentNote: In an emergency, call your national emergency number now — do not wait for this page to load.

errors.required: Enter the full tracking token from your receipt.
errors.notFound: No request found for that token. Check that you copied the whole token, then try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many searches. Wait a moment, then try again.
errors.validation: Check that you copied the whole token, then try again.
errors.unavailable: Tracking is temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.
errors.generic: Your request could not be checked. Try again.

auth.signInIntro: Sign in to reach staffing screens. Your administrator gives you an organization ID.
auth.organizationIdHint: The UUID under which this clinic is registered.
auth.mfaChallengeBody: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code for this account.
auth.mfaRecoveryHint: A code you were given when two-factor was set up.
auth.mfaCodeError: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
auth.mfaCancel: Sign in with a different account

errors.unauthorized: The email, password or organization ID is incorrect.
errors.mfa: That code was not accepted. The code may be wrong, or the sign-in may have expired. Sign in again and try the latest code.
errors.rateLimited: Too many sign-in attempts. Wait a moment, then try again.
errors.validation: Check the details and try again.
errors.unavailable: Sign-in is temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.
errors.generic: Sign-in could not be completed. Try again.
